verdict.rationale: Evidence shows only raw HTTP APIs (Events API, Stats API) and integration methods (script tag, WordPress plugin, GTM), but no official language SDKs (JS/Python/etc. client libraries) are documented. Probes further confirm no OpenAPI spec or machine-readable API definition exists (llms.txt, docs.md, openapi.json all 404), undermining any claim of an SDK-ready developer experience for AI-native building.
